# Jacob Vider

Physicist and instrumentation engineer. I build and test optical, electronic, and software systems for telescopes, from lab prototypes to space-mission data pipelines.

Most recently I was a Research Assistant at NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, developing the data reduction pipeline for a space-based telescope. 
Before that, I spent two years in the astronomy instrumentation lab at the University of Arizona, where I led the near-UV upgrade of the Super-LOTIS telescope and wrote first-author work I’m now publishing. I have a dual BA/BSc in Physics and Applied Physics from Clark University and Columbia Engineering.
